I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden. Wild autumn colors around the Matterhorn 🍁😳 This time of year, the higher elevation areas of Switzerland are full of beautiful fall colors, especially surrounding Zermatt. Their larch trees turn bright yellow and orange, which transforms this landscape into an autumn beauty. The Swiss Alps have many towns like this, but being able to see the Matterhorn in full view with these colors was something I’ll never forget! It was unbelievable seeing the entire progression of sunrise from start to finish.  🗓️ This footage was taken last season. Peak autumn colors typically happen mid-late October in this region, and can vary year-to-year. The “peak” colors normally last 3-4 days depending on the season, weather, and other conditions.  #swissalps #switzerland #alps #autumn #fall  Nature | Outdoors | Travel | Adventure | Cinematic | Hiking

✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.
